violation_type.title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))
violation_type.short_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area
violation_type.typical_finding: Diaper changes were observed at inspection and the diaper changing surface was not sanitized after any of the diaper changes.

finding_variants.text: Diaper changes were observed at inspection and the diaper changing surface was not sanitized after any of the diaper changes.
The diaper changing surface was not sanitized between changes. A non-absorbant paper liner was also not utilized for diaper changes.
Observed two children being changed without the changing table being cleaned between each changed child.
The diaper changing area was not sanitized in between diaper changes.     This was corrected at inspection when it was addressed with the caregiver and the diaper changing area was then sanitized.

There were items being stored  on three diaper changing tables in the classroom. These items included cleaning products, blankets, a marker, tape, diaper and diaper wipes.This was corrected at inspection when the items were removed from the changing table by the caregiver.
The diaper changing mat in one of the infant classrooms was observed with crumbs on it.    This was corrected at the inspection when the caregiver cleaned and sanitized the diaper changing mat.
